The first sum is
\[
\sum_{k,r\ge 0}\frac1{2^{2k}3^{2r+1}}
=\frac13\cdot \frac{1}{1-\frac14}\cdot \frac{1}{1-\frac19}
=\frac13\cdot \frac43\cdot \frac98
=\frac12.
\]

The second sum, with \(i\) odd and \(j\) even, is
\[
\sum_{k,r\ge 0}\frac1{2^{2k+1}3^{2r}}
=\frac12\cdot \frac43\cdot \frac98
=\frac34.
\]

Thus the total is
\[
\frac12+\frac34=\frac54.
\]
So \(m=5,\ n=4\), and
\[
100m+n=500+4=504.
\]

\[
\boxed{504}
\]
